name: Supplemental OMM Orbit Determination
description: Supplemental OMM orbit determination (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no FSB/FSO transport). fit: the flow's source modules' SDS $OEM (one object per frame, on the port of its provider: starlink, glonass, intelsat, cpf, iss) -> the frozen complete-arc OD core's epoch-specific $OMM, $OCM and $OBD, plus an SGP4-XP $OMM and $OBD for each full-day window of the ephemeris (propagator/sgp4-xp, the US Space Force Sgp4Prop joined in), each standard one size-prefixed record stream with the IngestRequest (INGQ) hostcap/storage-ingest files it by; one object an invocation, the rest yielded as backlog. Position-only sources (GLONASS SP3, Intelsat ECF, CPF) are fitted from positions alone in their own axes (Earth-fixed or EME2000; analysis/od refuses Earth-fixed frames), and an arc the core cannot fit is refused before it. FlowNotice (FNTC) on status: Info fitted (per object, the completion message), Skipped unfittable / fit-failed. publish_request: the IngestResult (INGR) storage-ingest answers + the IngestRequest it stored -> the dataset-publication POST (HttpRequest, HREQ; config omm_publish_url, nothing when unset or when the batch was refused). No capabilities but plugin.getConfig (publish_request).

methods.description: Source $OEM in -> one object fitted per invocation -> $OMM/$OCM/$OBD record streams, each with its IngestRequest, and a FlowNotice.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM (not size-prefixed), one object per frame.

inputPorts.description: data-source/spacex-starlink-source emit: one $OEM per Starlink object (compact, EME2000, UTC, with velocities).

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM (not size-prefixed), one object per frame.

inputPorts.description: data-source/glonass-source emit: one position-only $OEM per GLONASS satellite (Earth-fixed, GPS time).

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM (not size-prefixed), one object per frame.
SDS $OEM (not size-prefixed), one object per frame.

inputPorts.description: data-source/cpf-source emit: one position-only $OEM in the CPF's declared frame (Earth-fixed or EME2000, UTC).

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM (not size-prefixed), one object per frame.

inputPorts.description: data-source/iss-source emit: one $OEM (verbose, EME2000, UTC, with velocities).

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (INGQ) filing the stream beside it.

outputPorts.description: The IngestRequest for the omm stream: SCHEMA OMM.fbs, TAGS PROVIDER_ID supplemental-omm, SOURCE_NAME the provider (spacex-starlink, glonass, intelsat, cpf, iss), BATCH_ID the SHA-256 of the stream, CONTENT_KEY_ID public; PROVENANCE PARSER and NORMALIZED_SHA256/COUNT.
The object's $OMM records: the OD core's SGP4 set for each local epoch of the arc, then an SGP4-XP set (MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY SGP4XP) per full-day window.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (INGQ) filing the stream beside it.

outputPorts.description: The IngestRequest for the ocm stream: SCHEMA OCM.fbs, TAGS PROVIDER_ID supplemental-omm, SOURCE_NAME the provider (spacex-starlink, glonass, intelsat, cpf, iss), BATCH_ID the SHA-256 of the stream, CONTENT_KEY_ID public; PROVENANCE PARSER and NORMALIZED_SHA256/COUNT.
The object's $OCM records: the OD core's state and fit covariance for each local epoch.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (INGQ) filing the stream beside it.

outputPorts.description: The IngestRequest for the obd stream: SCHEMA OBD.fbs, TAGS PROVIDER_ID supplemental-omm, SOURCE_NAME the provider (spacex-starlink, glonass, intelsat, cpf, iss), BATCH_ID the SHA-256 of the stream, CONTENT_KEY_ID public; PROVENANCE PARSER and NORMALIZED_SHA256/COUNT.
The object's $OBD records: the OD core's fit diagnostics for each local epoch, then one per SGP4-XP window.

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (FNTC): Info fitted (ITEMS the completion message, COUNT the $OMM records, BATCH_ID the $OMM batch), Skipped unfittable / fit-failed (ITEMS the reason).

methods.description: IngestResult + IngestRequest -> the dataset-publication POST (omm_publish_url); nothing when unset or refused.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The IngestRequest the batch was stored by.
HttpRequest (HREQ) for hostcap/http-request: POST omm_publish_url, BODY the IngestResult, content-type application/octet-stream.
